learning_outcomes.text: Explains the operating principles of radio frequency amplifiers.
Analyzes the structures and operating mechanisms of oscillator circuits.
Explains and compares the basic principles of Amplitude Modulation (AM) systems.
Analyzes the operating structure of AM transmitter and receiver circuits.
Evaluates Frequency Modulation (FM) systems and circuits.

assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
